title: Two Sum
description: Given `N`, an array of `N` integers, and a `target` sum, find two distinct indices `i < j` such that `arr[i] + arr[j] == target`. Print `i j` (0-based). Assume exactly one valid pair exists.
instructions: Print the two 0-based indices `i j` separated by a space.
hints: Use a hash map / dictionary storing `value -> index` as you iterate.
For each `i`, check if `target - arr[i]` is already in the map.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input().strip())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
target = int(input().strip())
# Print i j
